description: Meteorological, agricultural, marine, disaster, and aviation deterministic threshold parameters for WeatherGPT.

max_wind_kmh.source: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Spray Advisory Protocol
max_wind_kmh.rationale: Winds exceeding 15 km/h cause droplet drift away from target foliage and contaminate surrounding plots or water bodies.

min_wind_kmh.source: FAO Guidelines on Good Practice for Ground Application of Pesticides
min_wind_kmh.rationale: Calm air (<3 km/h) creates thermal inversion where spray droplets hang suspended and fail to settle on crops.

max_rain_next_24h_mm.source: ICAR Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) Standard Operating Procedures
max_rain_next_24h_mm.rationale: Any rainfall >0.5 mm washes off freshly deposited foliar chemicals before systemic absorption can occur.

min_temp_celsius.source: ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) Plant Protection
min_temp_celsius.rationale: Temperatures below 12°C reduce stomatal opening and plant uptake of systemic agrochemicals.

max_temp_celsius.rationale: Temperatures above 35°C accelerate droplet evaporation and cause chemical scorching/phytotoxicity on crop leaf margins.

rain_threshold_next_24h_mm.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
rain_threshold_next_24h_mm.rationale: Forecast precipitation of >=5 mm satisfies surface crop water requirements; applying irrigation wastes groundwater and leads to waterlogging.

optimal_soil_moisture_pct.source: ICAR Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI)
optimal_soil_moisture_pct.rationale: Soil moisture exceeding 65% of field capacity indicates adequate root-zone hydration; further irrigation risks root hypoxia.

max_rain_probability_pct.source: ICAR Directorate of Wheat and Rice Research
max_rain_probability_pct.rationale: Rain probability exceeding 30% during harvest window increases grain moisture content and elevates post-harvest aflatoxin/fungal spoilage.

max_wind_gust_kmh.rationale: Wind gusts exceeding 35 km/h during crop maturity cause severe crop lodging (flattening of stalks) and grain shattering.

max_wave_height_meters.source: INCOIS (Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services) Ocean State Forecast
max_wave_height_meters.rationale: Significant wave heights above 2.0 meters produce treacherous sea conditions for motorized artisanal craft and small trawlers.

max_wind_knots.source: IMD Marine Weather Forecasting Protocol (Beaufort Scale 6 - Strong Breeze)
max_wind_knots.rationale: Sustained surface winds above 22 knots create steep whitecaps and squally conditions hazardous to small sea vessels.

coastal_alert_ban.source: INCOIS / NDMA Marine Cyclone Warning SOP
coastal_alert_ban.rationale: Any active Orange or Red coastal squall advisory mandates a total prohibition on offshore navigation beyond harbor limits.

moderate.rationale: Rainfall between 15 and 30 mm/hr overwhelms urban drains and initiates localized surface runoff.

heavy.rationale: Rainfall between 30 and 64 mm/hr triggers flash flooding in low-lying river catchments and road underpasses.

cloudburst.rationale: Rainfall exceeding 100 mm in a single hour over a 20-30 sq km parcel constitutes an emergency cloudburst.

warning.rationale: Wind gusts >50 km/h cause damage to thatched structures, uproot weak tree branches, and pose overhead wire hazards.

critical.rationale: Winds >75 km/h cause structural roof failures, uproot large trees, and demand preemptive shelter evacuation.

rain_prob_threshold_pct.rationale: Probability of precipitation above 35% justifies carrying personal rain gear for daily urban commutes.

precip_amount_mm.rationale: Precipitation exceeding 0.2 mm creates detectable wet ground and pedestrian discomfort.

hourly_rate_mm.source: Central Public Health & Environmental Engineering Organisation (CPHEEO) Storm Drainage Manual
hourly_rate_mm.rationale: Indian municipal drainage design capacity is typically 12-15 mm/hr; rates above this trigger rapid roadway flooding.

accumulation_3h_mm.source: Delhi PWD & Mumbai MCGM Monsoon Disaster SOP
accumulation_3h_mm.rationale: Cumulative 3-hour rainfall above 35 mm overwhelms subway pump sumps and underpass drainage reservoirs.

VFR.source: ICAO Annex 2 (Rules of the Air) & DGCA India CAR Section 9
VFR.rationale: Visual Flight Rules: Ceiling > 3,000 ft AGL and Visibility > 8,000 m (5 miles) permit visual flight navigation.

MVFR.rationale: Marginal VFR: Ceiling between 1,000-3,000 ft AGL and/or visibility 5,000-8,000 m requires heightened caution.

IFR.source: ICAO Annex 3 (Meteorological Service for International Air Navigation)
IFR.rationale: Instrument Flight Rules: Ceiling 500-1,000 ft AGL and/or visibility 1,500-5,000 m mandates instrument clearance.

LIFR.rationale: Low Instrument Flight Rules: Ceiling < 500 ft AGL or visibility < 1,500 m poses severe instrument approach restrictions.

temperature_delta_c.source: WMO Commission for Basic Systems (CBS) Ensemble Prediction Guidance
temperature_delta_c.rationale: Inter-model 2m temperature spread greater than 3.0°C indicates significant boundary-layer thermal uncertainty or front timing discrepancies.

precipitation_delta_mm.source: NCMRWF Operational Verification Standards for Multi-Model Ensembles
precipitation_delta_mm.rationale: Precipitation differences exceeding 8.0 mm in a 24-hour accumulation window represent convective parameterization divergences between GFS, ECMWF, and ICON.

wind_speed_delta_kmh.rationale: Surface wind differences above 15.0 km/h (approx 8 knots) directly affect coastal safety and crop spraying operational windows.
